This moss is found chiefly in mild temperate climates, especially in deciduous or mixed forests, and is best known in western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains easy to find.

Harwite moss, especially associated with Fangorn Forest, restores 10–50 concussion hits when swallowed. This is substantial healing for a substance relatively easy to find in a suitable habitat. Nevertheless it remains tied to the woodlands in which it is known to grow.
